blocks.text: Pontianak, Indonesia—Residents of Indonesia’s West Kalimantan province have endured devastating wildfires every few years, with toxic haze triggering illnesses, forcing schools to close and disrupting economic activity. Now, they are saying enough is enough. Lawyers have filed a class action case claiming “negligence, omission and failure” on the part of the government that has resulted in […]...
